title: Skybox Exodus
description: A broken story full of broken truths. A story of a treacherous tragedy displayed and shown in the form of dimensions and events.
body:
Something feels wrong above the clouds.

A lightweight horror-focused modpack built around [beyond_the_skybox](https://modrinth.com/mod/beyond_the_skybox), designed to keep the experience immersive without adding unnecessary content. The pack mainly includes performance mods, visual improvements, and small quality-of-life additions to make gameplay smoother while preserving the atmosphere of the original mod.

#
### **WARNING: THIS MOD CAN CRASH AND KICK YOU FROM YOUR GAME**
Singleplayer and multiplayer work fine.

---

[Beyond the Skybox](https://modrinth.com/mod/beyond_the_skybox) includes:
- 22 entities
- 35 events
- 12 structures
- 26 dimensions
- 1 Storyline

Other QoL Additions:
- Dynamic Lights
- Zoom
- LootR - per player loot
- A bunch of Performance Mods
